whenToUse: A website media library with folders, multi-select grid, uploads and alt-text details.
Content teams auditing missing alt text, unused files and storage.
avoidWhen: Picking one asset inside a form — use media-picker.
Just the library component without the page — use media-library.
a11y: Storage usage is role="meter" with aria-valuetext; the unused filter is aria-pressed.
Grid selection supports Shift and keyboard; announce the selected count to screen readers.
